configuration.resource_meaning: Host-token budget of one literal source observation page; controller total capacity remains separately enforced.

behavior: All visible Store sources remain searchable; current observation page preserves roles, unknown dates, source order and explicit Unicode character ranges.
READ actions navigate next/previous source pages and can deliver a bound current fragment or whole observed source through existing source visibility checks and exact return-budget admission.
Observation navigation alone never enters Reader evidence. Returned observed-source evidence includes its range and complete source character count.
Page operations consume the existing read allowance/control steps; no hidden unlimited traversal in production.
Unobserved arrival holes are not acknowledged by a far-away search hit or view refresh. Pending counts include arrivals beyond the current page.
Equal-clock late sources below an old lexical cursor are admitted using the stored boundary-ID set.
Existing fixed/context baselines continue choosing their search candidates; new page/observed-source READ options remain available to learned policies without silently changing the baseline recipe.

Source witness compilation skips navigation as a delivery label and checks direct observed-source READ against the same real source spans and complete return packet. Partial spans do not become whole-source sufficiency.
